Market today: Hot inflation is the big driver, keeping Fed rate hikes on the table. This is tough for your tech/chip names, especially with margin amplifying any downside.

Your holdings: SOXL (-75.35%), MUU (-58.82%), and SPAL (-44.45%) are in deep trouble. These leveraged ETFs amplify losses, and margin makes it worse.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your stops, especially on QQQ and QQQI, which are nearing their levels.

Bottom line: Inflation is a major headwind; focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: Respect the stop on QQQ at 670; a break could signal further downside for broad tech.
Consider trimming SOXL, MUU, and SPAL to reduce exposure to these heavily leveraged, decaying positions with massive losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
